stage: A4b bounded within-scope controls and A6 first applied working revision
scope: Retain release-specific receiver-removal and geographic-transfer sensitivity; no family-wide transfer theorem, no new estimator, no pruning or switching-policy validation programme.
reference: frozen existing metadata-derived 33; no coordinate changes and no inclusion of surplus JSON record

density.training_database: same existing 8000 fingerprint database row IDs
density.prediction_rule: restrict both database and queries to the same receiver subset; MinMax uses existing per-receiver intercepts (no pooled fit or imputation)
density.eligibility: at least three receptions on the subset for paired geometry comparison; FP additionally scored on all parent rows, with no assertion it needs three receptions
density.primary_reporting: each subset draw separately; treatment and selection median components plus availability; across-draw quantiles descriptive, not confidence intervals or independent message samples
density.new_numerical_uncertainty: conditional paired-message and 1000m-spatial bootstrap for each specified subset; no equivalence or family-wide winner claims; tiny populations visibly retained

geography.parent_calibration: existing 16612 calibration records only; evaluation from existing disjoint primary2495
geography.boundary: median UTM easting of existing calibration positions; west x<boundary, east x>=boundary
geography.budget: minimum of 8000, number of west calibration records, number of east calibration records; same budget for citywide and either opposite-half arm
geography.selection: random.Random(seed).sample for each of citywide,west,east pools, with original calibration iteration order as pool order
geography.roster: intersection of frozen33 receiver IDs having >=10 calibration receptions in ALL 9 sampled training arms; fixed across both directions and all repeats; no imputation
geography.evaluation: for each direction, parent primary rows in that half with >=3 receptions on the shared calibrated roster; no resampling/refill; same IDs within paired arms and all repeats
geography.fingerprinting: same sampled training IDs used for the fingerprint database and intercept fitting; k3, Euclidean RSSI, -200 fill, stable distance ties
geography.interpretation: conditional equal-budget contrast for this baseline and reference; geography includes route/receiver-coverage distribution shift, not geographic distance alone

inference.geography_other_repeats: point and per-message sensitivity records, no new independent-dataset interpretation
inference.multiplicity: no multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim; report all specified contrasts, median primary, p90 descriptive

stop_rule: complete these declared contrasts then integrate scope-selected manuscript/supplement text; do not open new experiments solely to recover stronger old conclusions
manuscript_gate: Working R1, not submission-ready; final primary-source bibliography and artifact version audit, author disposition review, and final A7 validation remain explicit gates.
